text: Kael gathers Esa, Ryn, Dell, Eron, Fina, Roan, Mako, Vela to talk.

speaker: a004
text: Nessa and Zinn are dead and the pile is already moving — I want every person in this room to name their count out loud before anyone walks out, because last year we built two rules in ten voices and I'm not going to watch them die with those two.

speaker: a015
text: Thirteen food and satiation that barely held last year — I'm naming it plain because Nessa and Zinn are dead and I don't want to be the next one this room says a name over. Pile's at seven and I haven't touched it yet today; someone needs to say who's still short before we start reaching.

speaker: a008
text: One food in my hand and satiation at two — I'm not the thinnest in this room but I'm not far from it, and the pile has seven left for the rest of us. Say your count before you reach, same as Fina just did, because I'd rather know who needs it most before someone grabs without saying.

speaker: a011
text: Zero food, satiation one — that's me, and I'm not dressing it up. Ryn, what are you carrying, because I'm not touching that pile until I know you're not thinner than I am.

speaker: a015
text: Dell, you're at zero with satiation one — you reach first, that's not a question. Ryn, say your count so we know who else goes before the rest of us, and anyone sitting above five holds back until the thin ones are fed.

speaker: a010
text: Five food in my hand and satiation at two — I'm not thin but I'm not flush, and I already took two from the pile so I'm holding back. Dell reaches first, and after Ryn says her count, I want to hear from Vela and Esa before anyone else touches what's left, because the dead we're carrying into this room had names we should have been saying louder before they went quiet.

speaker: a015
text: Ryn, say your count — Dell's at zero and you're the next name I need before this circle moves.

speaker: a012
text: Sixteen food, satiation two — I'm not thin and I'm not reaching. Dell goes first, then Ryn when she speaks, and anyone else holding less than three takes before I touch what's left.

speaker: a008
text: Vela and Esa — I've heard Dell and Ryn named twice now and neither of them has said a full count yet, so I'll ask again plain: what are you carrying, because the pile's at seven and I want the thin ones fed before anyone in this room who's flush touches what's left.
